PALADIN — stands with unwavering conviction, radiating divine authority through every gesture, eyes burning with righteous purpose and unshakeable faith in sacred oaths sworn.
ROGUE — moves through shadows with liquid grace, perpetually calculating angles and exits, fingers restless and eyes sharp with opportunistic cunning and practiced deception.
WIZARD — carries himself with scholarly detachment, air shimmering faintly around him, gaze distant as if reading invisible formulae written across reality itself.
BARBARIAN — prowls with barely-contained ferocity, muscles coiled like a predator's, every movement raw power tempered only by warrior's discipline and tribal wisdom.
RANGER — stands alert with wilderness-honed stillness, tracking imperceptible signs, moving with the patient efficiency of one who hunts and is hunted in equal measure.
WARLOCK — bears an otherworldly presence, eyes holding eldritch secrets, movements marked by unnatural grace granted through pacts with powers beyond mortal comprehension.
CLERIC — projects serene authority blessed by divine favor, hands steady with healing purpose, bearing the weight of faith like a mantle of celestial responsibility.
DRUID — moves with nature's unhurried rhythm, posture open to earth and sky, eyes reflecting primal forces and the patient inevitability of seasons turning.
MONK — centers himself in perfect balance, each motion deliberately controlled, breathing synchronized with inner energy flowing through disciplined channels of martial meditation.
BARD — carries charismatic magnetism in every flourish, movements theatrical yet genuine, voice and presence commanding attention through practiced charm and inspirational confidence.
NECROMANCER — stands shrouded in deathly stillness, pale fingers conducting unseen forces, bearing the cold certainty of one who communes with mortality's darkest mysteries.
SORCERER — crackles with barely-leashed elemental power, movements unpredictable and charged, magic bleeding from his very presence like storm-pressure before lightning strikes.
KNIGHT — bears himself with courtly discipline and martial pride, spine straight with noble obligation, every gesture measured by codes of chivalry and honored tradition.
ARTIFICER — surveys surroundings with inventive scrutiny, hands stained by creative labor, mind constantly dismantling and reconstructing reality through mechanical innovation and arcane engineering.
SHAMAN — sways between worlds with trance-touched awareness, eyes seeing spirits invisible to others, channeling ancestral voices and elemental forces through ritual communion.
ARCANIST — maintains meticulous precision in stance and gesture, weaving complex patterns through air, intellect sharp as he unravels magical theory into devastating practical application.
WARRIOR — plants himself with veteran's confidence, battle-scarred and unflinching, bearing physical prowess honed through countless conflicts and tactical experience earned in blood.
INQUISITOR — watches with penetrating judgment, posture rigid with zealous certainty, presence heavy with authority to root out heresy through relentless interrogation and divine sanction.
BLOODMAGE — moves with feverish intensity, pulse visible at throat, channeling vitality itself into power, bearing the dangerous edge of one gambling lifeforce for sorcery.
BATTLEMAGE — balances warrior's stance with arcane focus, combat-ready yet channeling mystical forces, merging martial prowess and spellcraft into seamless deadly synthesis.
SHADOW PRIEST — drifts between darkness and faith, wielding divine power through umbral channels, bearing paradoxical grace of one serving light through embrace of shadow.
WARDEN — stands as living boundary between civilization and wilderness, bearing protective vigilance, equally comfortable enforcing natural law and defending settled lands from encroachment.
HEXBLADE — carries curse-touched presence, movements traced by spectral afterimages, bound to eldritch patrons through supernatural compact manifesting as palpable menace and occult dread.
RUNECASTER — inscribes invisible symbols through purposeful gestures, bearing ancient knowledge etched into memory, channeling primordial languages that reshape reality through carved meaning.
TEMPLAR — marches with militant devotion, bearing blessed purpose like banner into battle, zealous faith armoring him against doubt as he crusades for sacred cause.
ASSASSIN — carries himself like a shadow that learned to walk, smiles like someone who knows where every blade in the room is hidden.
DEATHKNIGHT — walks with the grim certainty of something that died and came back wrong, aura making horses shy and dogs whimper nervously.
BERSERKER — scarred and massive, controlled violence radiating from every controlled breath, presence promising that restraint is temporary and costly to maintain.
SHADOWMANCER — moves through spaces like he's not entirely there, eyes flat and cold, carrying darkness that seems to follow half a step behind.
NIGHTBLADE — moves with predator's silence, bearing the hard-won economy of someone who's survived by being faster and crueler than the competition.
DEMONOLOGIST — wrongness radiates subtly from his presence, eyes holding knowledge of things that writhe and bargain, smile promising prices always come due.
BLACKGUARD — carries himself with the dark authority of oaths broken and reforged in blood, presence commanding through sheer brutal certainty and scars.
HUNTER — eyes tracking movement others miss, patience of something that has waited days for one clean moment, weathered by wind and the weight of necessary culling.
DEATH KNIGHT — stands with the unnatural stillness of something that has crossed back from the grave, presence cold enough to frost nearby breath.
DEMON HUNTER — bears the taint of what he kills, sacrifices carved into flesh and soul, hunting monsters with monstrous methods.
WAR-PRIEST — blesses and breaks with equal conviction, doctrine learned in trenches, faith expressed through violence sanctified by necessity.
BATTLE-MAGE — carries the coiled stillness of contained devastation, fingers stained with residue of forces that left older men shattered or mad.
KNIGHT-ERRANT — road-worn and disillusioned, carrying the remnants of honor like old scars, ideals weathered down to the bleak core of survival and duty.
